name: Marksman Revolver
description: (Tag:kinetic)(Tag:tech)(Tech) An incredibly high-tech revolver outclassing anti-tank rounds, manifesting up to 4 throwable gold coins. Hitting a coin ricochets the bullet toward the closest hittable weak point, growing stronger with each chained coin. It fires high-velocity metal shards with extreme efficiency lasting days of shooting, replenishable by adding more metal.
